title: The rigidification identity-action cocone is the pinched-resolution comparison
statement:
Use quasicategories, internal functor simplicial sets, right-pinched mapping spaces, realization and weak homotopy equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Work in fixed universes large enough for all displayed constructions. Let $\mathcal S$ be the infinity category of Kan complexes in the value universe, as defined in [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Let $C$ be a small quasicategory, $a,x$ vertices, $A=\mathfrak C[C]$, and let $H:C\to\mathcal S$ be the specific coherent functor of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], with $H(z)=\operatorname{Sing}|A(a,z)|$ and enriched action given by postcomposition after the singular-realization unit. Let $\eta\in H(a)$ be the singular vertex of the identity of $A(a,a)$, and put $M_x=\operatorname{Map}^{R}_C(a,x)$. Apply $H$ to the right-pinch family $M_x\times\Delta^1\to C$ of [lem-coef-infinity-pinch-comparison] and precompose with the constant point $\eta:*\to H(a)$. This gives an actual coherent cocone $\lambda_x:\Delta_{M_x}*\to\Delta_{M_x}H(x)$. Let $e_x:M_x\to H(x)$ be its point map, up to homotopy, under the constant-diagram equivalence of [lem-coef-space-point-cocone-criterion].

Use the cosimplicial simplicial set $Q$, coend $V(K)=|K|_Q$, natural map $p_K:V(K)\to K$, and specified map $\theta_{C,a,x}:V(M_x)\to A(a,x)$ of [lem-coef-pinched-rigidification-resolution]. Write $u_{a,x}:A(a,x)\to\operatorname{Sing}|A(a,x)|$ for the singular-realization unit (the map taking a simplex to its characteristic continuous simplex). In the category obtained from simplicial sets by formally inverting all weak homotopy equivalences, write $[f]$ for the image of a map $f$. The following equality holds:
$$[e_x]\,[p_{M_x}]=[u_{a,x}]\,[\theta_{C,a,x}].$$
In particular, the actual point map $e_x$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. The equality identifies the point map of the displayed action cocone, including all its simplicial parameters, rather than merely agreeing on vertices or connected components. It is natural under maps of $(C,a,x)$ and is unchanged by regarding the same Kan complexes and functors in a containing universe.

source.place: Section 2.2.4, opening paragraph before Proposition 2.2.4.1 (printed p. 88): the composite into a locally Kan enriched Hom is the Q-evaluation counit; Section 5.1.3, opening construction (printed pp. 319–320): Sing-realization enriched Hom functor. The identity-action specialization and the precise cocone comparison are expanded by the worker in report.md. Kerodon 038A specifies the universal-element action being identified. No Stacks tag states this comparison; sources read online, archival extracts WANTED.

from.place: Proof paragraph 2, the displayed derived coefficient mapping-complex adjunction: evaluation at an identity extracts the universal map from a representing equivalence before applying the local coherent adjoint criterion. Technical foundation: match the identity-action cocone of the explicitly defined rigidification functor with its pinched-resolution comparison, before extracting a transformation by identity evaluation.
